meta.name: i18n-validate
meta.description: Validate translation completeness and consistency across all locale files — detect missing keys, untranslated strings, format mismatches, and glossary violations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证多语言翻译文件的一致性与完整性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责多语言项目的翻译质量
copy.tagline_en: Validate translation consistency and completeness across locale files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage translation quality in multilingual projects

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查你的项目里所有语言翻译文件，找出缺失翻译、未使用的键、占位符不一致、文本超长、JSON 语法错误和术语表违规等问题，并输出带严重级别的错误与警告列表。
howto.when: 在完成翻译后、提交代码前，或每次 Pull Request 时，要求它验证翻译文件即可触发。

say.text: 请验证 locales/ 下英、法、德翻译是否完整。
say.note: Claude 会检查缺失键和未翻译项。

say.text: 检查当前翻译文件有没有占位符不匹配。
say.note: Claude 会对比各语言的模板变量。

say.text: 跑一遍 i18n 验证，重点关注长度预算。
say.note: Claude 会标记超出长度限制的译文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will scan all your locale files, detect missing translations, orphaned keys, placeholder mismatches, text length violations, JSON syntax errors, and glossary misalignments, then output a report with errors and warnings by severity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to validate translations after completion, before committing code, or on each pull request.

say_en.text: Validate the translation completeness for EN, FR, DE in locales/.
say_en.note: Claude checks missing keys and untranslated strings.

say_en.text: Check for placeholder mismatches in all locale files.
say_en.note: Claude compares template variables across languages.

say_en.text: Run i18n validation focusing on length budget.
say_en.note: Claude flags translations exceeding allowed lengths.
